title: Primex Anarchy
body:
#  PrimeX Anarchy - PXA

PrimeX Anarchy is one of the most intense and legendary Minecraft anarchy servers in India, delivering a true no-rules survival experience since 2020.

##  No Rules.
Build, destroy, raid, and dominate — everything is allowed. The world is completely player-driven where only skill, strategy, and power matter.

###  Origin:
 Kerala, India 🇮🇳
Built for the Indian (especially Malayali) Minecraft community, PrimeX has grown into a chaotic battlefield where trust is rare and survival is everything.

** What You Can Expect**:

Full Anarchy Gameplay (No Bans / No Restrictions)

Hardcore PvP & Raiding

Massive Player Wars & Betrayals

Unlimited Base Building & Destruction

A Toxic, Competitive, and Addictive Experience

###  Create Your Legacy

Join thousands of warriors and prove your dominance in the ultimate survival battlefield.
